svg.title: Site plan — setbacks and the buildable envelope (fictional)

g.text: The envelope is not a building: it is the lot with the yards taken out.
Coverage counts footprints; overhangs up to 30 in and low decks usually do not.
Floor area ratio is floor area over lot area, so a second storey costs nothing in coverage.
Zone, dimensions and the lot are fictional. Local rules differ everywhere.
